name: e2e-meeting-notes
description: Schema for extracting people and architecture decisions from meeting notes. Used by e2e extraction tests.

objectTypeSchemas.name: Person
objectTypeSchemas.description: A person mentioned in the document, with their name and role.

name.description: The full name of the person.

role.description: The person's title or role (e.g., VP of Engineering, Lead Architect).

objectTypeSchemas.name: Decision
objectTypeSchemas.description: An architecture or product decision recorded in the document.

title.description: A short title summarising what was decided.

decided_by.description: The person or group who made the decision.

relationshipTypeSchemas.name: mentions
relationshipTypeSchemas.description: Links a decision to a person
